segments.text:
Zeale and Zealouſneſſe.
Men ought to be Zealous, in the defence of Gods truth. 625. b •.
VVith what zeale a Chriſtian ought to defend God and godly matters 713. a 14 b.
VVhere modeſtie is not, there Zeale and deſirouſneſſe to ſpeake, are to be diſcommended. 616. a 47.
Zealouſneſſe ought to be guided by reaſon. 616. a 31.
Moyſes caried away with Zealouſneſſe. 59. a 27.
